issues.summary: verify vc5 --target <name> fails with --targets-json invalid JSON while positional target invocation works
issues.impact: Source-worker handoffs and agent validation can fail when using the stale --target selector shape even though the same VC5 manifest runs successfully as a positional selector; this slows validation but has a safe positional workaround.
issues.next_action: Inspect tools/recoil.py and tools/_recoil/commands/vc5_verify.py command routing. Either support --target <name> as an alias for the positional target selector or update agent-facing docs/handoffs so they never use the unsupported selector.

history.note: Issue recorded for future agent tooling/process repair.

Resolved the VC5 selector parsing defect by adding an explicit repeatable verify-vc5 --target selector alias. The previous behavior came from argparse treating --target as an abbreviation for --targets-json, causing plain target names to be parsed as invalid JSON. The alias now routes through the same explicit selector path as positional target names and preserves --targets-json behavior. Parent validation passed: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --target hud_ui_background_load_zrd --skip-bn-compare; python -m unittest tests.tools.recoil_vc5_verify_tests; python tools/recoil.py issue audit --strict. Tool-maintainer validation also passed recoil_cli_tests and agent-surface audit.

issues.actual: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --target hud_ui_background_load_zrd fails with --targets-json: invalid JSON; python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 hud_ui_background_load_zrd runs the expected VC5 verification target.
